description: This Java source file implements a default diagnostic logging adapter for the Akka framework, specifically for the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods for setting correlation IDs, MDC entries, and logging messages with different severity levels, leveraging state pattern techniques to manage logging contexts.

classes.name: DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A final class that implements a diagnostic logging adapter with extended functionalities for correlation ID and MDC management, and interacts with underlying logging adapters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter with specified Akka DiagnosticLoggingAdapter and logger name.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for logging context, either from a CharSequence or from Ditto headers.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Explicitly sets a correlation ID, updating MDC entries.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC entries.

methods.name: setMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates an MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entry with a specific key and value.

methods.name: setMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries at once.

methods.name: discardMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific MDC entry based on its key.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
methods.description: Clears all MDC entries.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Puts a MDC entry for the current logger context.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC entry to the auto-discarding logger context.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific MDC entry from the current logger context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current logger.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info-level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug-level logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message.

methods.name: notifyWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message.

methods.name: notifyInfo
methods.description: Logs an informational message.

methods.name: notifyDebug
methods.description: Logs a debug message.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as an immutable Map.

methods.name: setMDC
methods.description: Sets the entire MDC from a Map.

methods.name: clearMDC
methods.description: Clears all MDC entries.
